context:
Goal: the 4 test commits of the restyle step 8 lane reach PR 238 on GitHub.
Problem (rule): the push guard refuses the lane's 4 test commits while earlier commit 5b4f3fa has no Red-run trailer, and only your typed override or your word to rewrite that pushed commit can clear it.
Based on (read): decision red-run-trailer-on-test-commits: a commit that adds test lines needs a Red-run trailer, either with a failed run or the form Red-run: none: <reason>, and a reword of a pushed branch needs the owner.
Based on (notes): the coordinator says the case failed in run 43762232891, so the owed reason is true.
Departs from: main, where 5b4f3fa has no trailer — option a lets the push go through on your typed override, and option b adds the trailer by rewriting 5b4f3fa.
Meanwhile: the lane holds 4 test commits unpushed and works on nothing that needs the push.
holds: Lane restyle-step8 holds 4 test commits unpushed until you answer.
home: lane restyle-step8 (PR 238); decision red-run-trailer-on-test-commits in claude-settings

lastAnswer.note: Owner in chat, 20:29 CST (relayed by the coordinator): "B". Amend 5b4f3fa with a Red-run: none: owed trailer, which rewrites PR 238's history. Archive branch first.

options.gain: The lane pushes at once and no pushed history changes.
options.how: You type override 15m in the restyle-step8 lane's session. The lane then pushes its 4 test commits as they are, and nothing on PR 238 is rewritten.
options.label: Type override 15m in the lane's session
options.lose: Commit 5b4f3fa stays without a trailer, so the PR's own Red-run check may still name it.

options.gain: The commit carries the trailer, so the check passes with no override.
options.how: The lane amends 5b4f3fa to add: Red-run: none: owed, case failed in run 43762232891. It then pushes with the branch rewritten.
options.label: Amend 5b4f3fa with a Red-run none trailer
options.lose: It rewrites pushed history on PR 238, which cannot be undone, and any other copy of the branch must be reset.

ref: PR 238 (the restyle step 8 pull request); commit 5b4f3fa (a test commit on it); decision red-run-trailer-on-test-commits (a commit that adds test lines carries the red run of those lines); run 43762232891 (the pro-ui-b run where the case failed)
reply: Answered b at 20:29 CST in chat: lane restyle-step8 amends 5b4f3fa with the Red-run none trailer, after pushing an archive copy of the branch first. Home is lane restyle-step8; the coordinator routes it.

shown.label: Type override 15m in the lane's session
Amend 5b4f3fa with a Red-run none trailer

title: Commit 5b4f3fa on PR 238 has no red-run trailer and blocks the lane's push. Type an override, or amend the commit?
why: An override changes nothing in the branch, while an amend rewrites pushed history and cannot be undone.
